title: US Bell - New Area Codes
summary: A sketch from the Seattle comedy show Almost Live! in which Pat Cashman plays a US Bell rep explaining the new 425 area code. It first aired in 1997.
why: Seattle-area commenters bring it up as a nostalgic local joke when area codes or Eastside versus Seattle rivalry come up.
